name: dts-bot

scripts.test: node test/test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs && node test/executor.test.mjs && node --import ./test/stubs/register.mjs test/worker.test.mjs

description: DTS bot: TradingView signals executed on Paradex from your own Cloudflare account, with a Telegram kill switch.

PARADEX_ACCOUNT.description: Your Paradex **account address** (starts with `0x`), from Apple Passwords. Not a key. Not ready yet? Type `later`.

PARADEX_PRIVATE_KEY.description: The **trade-only subkey** you created in the Paradex app (testnet first), from Apple Passwords. Never your wallet key. Not ready yet? Type `later`.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: The **Telegram bot token** BotFather gave you, from Apple Passwords (user name `Telegram bot token`).

SIGNAL_SECRET.description: Your **Signal secret** from Apple Passwords (website `dts.bot`). TradingView sends it with every alert.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Your **Admin token** from Apple Passwords (website `dts.bot`). Your master password for the bot.

CONTROL.description: The halt switch. Nothing to fill in.

ENGINE.description: The trading engine, one per market. Nothing to fill in.
